<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex010022026-09-1606-23-28" status="unreviewed">de nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">slob dpon seng ge bzang po</rs>s <rs type="person" ana="">'phags pa rnam par grol sde</rs>'i rjes su 'phrangs nas <rs type="work">mdo' le'u brgyad ma</rs> dang <rs type="work">bstan bcos su sbyar ba'i mdo'i bsdus don gyi 'grel pa le'u brgyad ma</rs> 'di mdzad do ||

      <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">shan ta ra ki ta</rs> ni bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo la le'u mangs ma dang le'u brgyad ma 2 su med zer ba dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re mdo gong 'ga 'khrugs pa bsdebs kyang | 'gres mi 'dra * le'u mangs la legs pa yod la | 'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">'bum</rs> ltar rgyas par snang la lar bsdus par rnam bas mdo' 2 su yod par gsal gsung lo |</note></seg></TEI>
